import pickle
import pytest

import jinja2.filters


def test_issue_1612_async_variant_pickleable():
    """
    Filters decorated with @async_variant should be pickleable.
    """
    # The do_first filter is decorated with @async_variant
    # and was specifically mentioned in the bug report.
    # If the bug is present, this will raise a PicklingError.
    # The expected behavior is that it should be pickleable.
    pickled_filter = pickle.dumps(jinja2.filters.do_first)
    unpickled_filter = pickle.loads(pickled_filter)

    # Verify that the unpickled function is indeed the same as the original
    # in terms of its identity (or at least its name and qualname)
    assert unpickled_filter.__name__ == "do_first"
    assert unpickled_filter.__qualname__ == "do_first"
    assert unpickled_filter is not jinja2.filters.do_first # It's a new object after pickling/unpickling
    assert unpickled_filter.__module__ == jinja2.filters.do_first.__module__

    # Additionally, verify that the __name__ is correct on the original function
    # as this was part of the root cause described in the bug report.
    assert jinja2.filters.do_first.__name__ == "do_first"
    assert jinja2.filters.do_first.__qualname__ == "do_first"
